primary_meaning: Representatives of the redeemed people of God (the Church and/or Israel) in the heavenly throne room

alternatives.meaning: The twelve tribes of Israel plus the twelve apostles, symbolizing the complete people of God
Angelic beings or members of a heavenly/divine council
basis: Parallels to OT divine council and throne-room scenes (e.g., Job 1–2, 1 Kings 22)

alternatives.meaning: Representatives of the Old Testament priesthood (the 24 priestly courses)
basis: Priestly actions such as offering incense and harps in Revelation 5:8

alternatives.meaning: Literal human church leaders or elders without further apocalyptic symbolism

notes: The ordinary biblical sense of elders as community or church leaders is settled and non-symbolic. Symbolic discussion concentrates almost entirely on the twenty-four elders of Revelation, where multiple readings remain in play and no single interpretation has achieved consensus across Christian traditions.
